title: Kiosk Return: Damaged or Missing
lede: One quiet link on the return screen opens its own page: damaged means describe it and take a photo, and the item is held for staff; missing means mark it and tell staff, and the return can finish without it. The receipt names each.

sections.heading: Side by side
sections.note: Before = HEAD c9e71a91 build, after = working tree; same created simulator, same fixture co-1.

pairs.title: G1 · return, nothing scanned
pairs.beforeCap: No way to report a problem at the kiosk.
pairs.afterCap: 'Something damaged or missing?' link above Finish return.

sections.heading: New frames (after only)
sections.note: No before exists: the kiosk had no report page and the return receipt was a single sentence.

shots.title: G3 · which item, what happened
shots.cap: CAM-014 is back; AUD-007 picked. Damaged needs the item scanned back first, so it is disabled for AUD-007; missing is offered.

shots.title: G4 · damaged
shots.cap: Describe it plus a photo. The simulator has no camera, so it shows 'No camera here. Describe it instead.' The Open camera path is device-only.

shots.title: G5 · missing
shots.cap: Decision 4 copy: accounted for, so the return can finish without it. No 'stays on your record'.

shots.title: G6 · receipt
shots.cap: Returned, Held for staff, and Marked missing cards.

changes.was: Nothing at the kiosk; web only.
changes.now: Its own page from one link: pick a serialized item, then It's damaged / It's missing.
Multipart POST /api/kiosk/checkin/{id}/report (type DAMAGED, description, optional JPEG under 4.5 MB). Still counts as returned; the server holds the asset for staff. The row reads 'Held for staff'.

type LOST. Counted as accounted for: the Finish pill reads 'N back · 1 missing', the still-out check skips it, and if it was the last item out the server finishes the return and the kiosk goes straight to the receipt.
Receipt cards: Returned (count, tags, ref), then Held for staff and Marked missing.
